create_equal_weight: create an EqualExampleWeight instance that returns constant weight 1.0 for all users
create_linear_weight: create a LinearExampleWeight instance that weights users proportionally to their number of examples
create_sqrt_weight: create a SqrtExampleWeight instance that weights users by the square root of their examples
create_log10_weight: create a Log10ExampleWeight instance that weights users by log10 of their number of examples
review_ExampleWeight_weight: review the ExampleWeight weight method that normalizes raw weights by avg_num_examples
